content.short: Equine NFT is a blockchain horse racing game with tradable horses, jockeys, skins, and customization.
content.description: Equine NFT is a blockchain horse racing game built around ownership of horses, jockeys, skins, and related game assets. Players can trade, buy, and sell equine NFTs through the marketplace while participating in a racing ecosystem supported by smart contracts. The project focuses on making each horse feel distinct through customization options and digital ownership. Equine NFT brings racing, collecting, and marketplace activity together as a Cardano Web3 game with tradable assets and competitive play.
